notes: Italic 'with' moved from added to the bare appositional nominal הַמְשֹׁרְרִים under rule 33 (appositional nominal introduced by a supplied preposition); the italic corroborates the supply but is not an added label, rule 7.
'had' marked added: עַל already holds its own 'upon', and rule 43 reads a spent preposition as no home for the have; the alternative 'had upon' on עַל is named in the unit note.
Marginal note on הַמַּשָּׂא read and set aside under rule 38.
